Enemy armfav at our home extractors are not its business once it has left spot_18.

Raids on our base come before everything: an enemy party at our extractors, constructors or home is answered at once by the nearest Blitz group with the whole group, whatever it was gathering for or walking to; the route resumes when none stands in our base. They outrun Blitzes, so a chase is not the point: Blitzes standing on what the raiders want drive them off or kill them, so the group goes to the building they are shooting and fights there. Plan: we start at G1
